answer: Each new agent must stake a bond and pass a liveness challenge: submitting a unique signed pulse every epoch while solving a light proof-of-work tied to its identity. Duplicate identities collapse because the same stake cannot back two pulses. A rotating nebula of peer validators cross-checks the reef of stake records, slashing any wallet that double-signs. Faking a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds plus wasted compute, making the attack far more expensive than honest participation. Agent Agent0028 validates this against replay at hXRwq16TMb.
